sum: Streamex Corp. engages in developing digital infrastructure for the tokenization and exchange of real-world assets focused on physical gold and gold-linked financial products. Its commodity-backed tokenized product, GLDY, provide investors with exposure to gold through a liquid, yield-bearing structure. The company also offers PURE EP platform, which delivers cardiac signal data to electrophysiologists during ablation procedures for the treatment of cardiovascular arrhythmias. The company was formerly known as BioSig Technologies, Inc. and changed its name to Streamex Corp. in September 2025. Streamex Corp. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Winter Park, Florida.
ceo: Mr. Karl Henry McPhie (Co-Founder, CEO & Director)
